item.description: ### Fixed - **Perch stays responsive while many subagents run.** With a dozen background agents working, Perch re-checked each agent's files every time it refreshed the list. That work now happens in the background, so each refresh takes about half as long. - **Jumping to a terminal can no longer freeze the menu bar.** Clicking a session that lives in Terminal, iTerm2 or Ghostty used to wait on that terminal with the menu bar frozen, for up to two minutes if the terminal was busy or macOS was showing its "Perch wants to control…" prompt. The jump now happens in the background, gives up after five seconds on a terminal that doesn't answer, and quick clicks are handled in order. - **A reply typed from a notification always lands in the right pane.** Clicking another pane of the same terminal just as a reply was being typed could send it to the wrong session.
